data.body: GAP-ANALYSIS BLOCKER (F2): cde1-30ba is currently STATUS=open. This story cannot proceed AT ALL until cde1 closes. cde1's DoD ships a Mutation dataclass (NOT tuples) with fields (direction, action, target, payload, provenance) plus the redesigned compute_mutations(local_state, jira_state) signature. Sprint MUST verify cde1 status=closed before dispatching T2/T3. T1 (inbound_probe.py module) can be dispatched ahead of cde1 because it doesn't touch differ/applier.
